name: Yatai (food stalls)

cells.what: A cart set up at the same place every night on a street or in a park
cells.rules: Road-use, road-occupancy and restaurant permits; a city ordinance since 2013; new pitches by public competition since 2016
cells.food: Pork-bone ramen, yakitori, oden; no raw food
cells.know: About 100 stalls; few seats; mostly cash; at least one drink and one dish each

cells.what: Stalls assembled for each festival or fair
cells.rules: Restaurant permit, or a temporary notice by a local organiser; road-use permit on streets
cells.food: Simple food heated just before serving, such as takoyaki, karaage, oden (Osaka's rules)
cells.know: Run by travelling traders known as tekiya or yashi

cells.rules: Restaurant permit (vehicle); in Fukuoka valid six years, city-wide
